defect.defect: ORDER_UNKNOWN_NONCOMPARABLE is not an order basis. It carries permits_direction false and emits the refusal states TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE or TEMPORAL_ORDER_UNAUTHORIZED, one of which means 'no permitted order basis applies'. Yet TEMPORAL_RELATION_RECEIPT.temporal_order_basis_ref is required and defined as 'Exact ref to the AUTHORIZED order basis ... Always present, including when the basis is one that yields no direction'.
defect.conflation: 'yields no direction' (a property of an authorized partial basis) is conflated with 'no order basis applies' (an absence of basis).
consequences: TEMPORAL_ORDER_UNAUTHORIZED is reachable two ways (ref absent, and ref present but unknown) with no distinction
a receipt can hold an authorized-basis field pointing at a value that denies any basis exists
